text:
elaine_s: FYI — Acme Corp's procurement/security team asked for SIEM integration details, retention windows, and admin activity/audit trail evidence for the SIG/CAIQ. POC kickoff Wed. Need a concise artifact we can send to the buyer by EOD Tue.

sam_se: Can you paste the exact questions they sent? want to map to specific SIG sections.

elaine_s: They asked: 'How do you capture admin actions? What are default retention periods for logs (API, admin, auth, model inference)? Do you support real-time forwarding to customer SIEM (Syslog/Splunk/Datadog)? Can logs be exported to customer-managed storage and encrypted with their KMS?'

kiran_sec: Ok, quick mapping:
- Admin activity/audit trail -> SIG v4.2 / CAIQ CCM-07 (auditability)
- Retention & archival -> SIG v4.5 (retention)
- SIEM forwarding & streaming -> SIG v4.3 (monitoring)
- Customer-managed key & immutable archives -> CAIQ CCM-08 / legal e-discovery notes

kiran_sec: Short evidence bundle we can send (draft):
1) One-page summary (controls + where logs live + retention).
2) Sample audit event schema + 2 example events.
3) Technical notes: SIEM forwarder config (syslog + S3), KMS config, immutability/append-only settings.
4) Statement of default retention + options (export/archival SLA).

sam_se: Perfect — can you paste the sample event schema and a tiny syslog config here so I can drop into the buyer email?

kiran_sec: Sure. Keep it short.

kiran_sec: Sample audit event (JSON schema):
```json
{
  "event_type": "admin_action",
  "timestamp": "2025-10-14T16:12:03Z",
  "actor": {
    "id": "u_12345",
    "email": "alice@redwood.com",
    "role": "org_admin"
  },
  "action": "update_instance_config",
  "target": {
    "resource_id": "deployment-xyz",
    "resource_type": "deployment"
  },
  "details": {
    "fields_changed": ["max_seq_len","batching_policy"],
    "old": {"max_seq_len":1024},
    "new": {"max_seq_len":2048}
  },
  "request_id": "req_7890",
  "ip": "34.56.78.90",
  "trace_id": "trace-abc-123"
}
```

kiran_sec: Minimal SIEM forwarding example (rsyslog -> tcp to Splunk HEC or customer syslog):
```bash
# /etc/rsyslog.d/50-redwood-siem.conf
module(load="imfile")
input(type="imfile" File="/var/log/redwood/audit.log" Tag="redwood-audit" Severity="info")
*.* @@splunk-hec.example.com:514 # TCP forwarding (TLS in prod)
```

kiran_sec: We also support streaming via our internal forwarder to S3 (for long-term archive) with server-side encryption. Customers can supply an S3 bucket ARN + external KMS key. We write gzipped newline-delimited JSON and set Object Lock in GOVERNANCE mode if they need immutability.

elaine_s: Nice. What's the default retention policy we currently state in standard Hosted agreements? They asked specifically for numbers.

kiran_sec: Defaults (hosted):
- API call logs (request/response metadata, no payload storage by default): 90 days hot, 13 months cold
- Admin/audit trails (user actions, config changes): 1 year by default; optional 7-year archival to customer S3 via contract
- Auth/IDP events (login, token issues): 13 months
- Model inference telemetry (latency, errors, anonymized latents): 90 days unless customer enables longer retention for debugging

kiran_sec: Note: For Dedicated/Private deployments we can set retention to customer policy and point logs directly to their SIEM or S3; retention/immutability handled by their infra and our installer documents.

sam_se: Can you add a one-liner about encryption + access controls for the one-pager?

kiran_sec: Copy/paste friendly line: "All logs are encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS1.2+). Customer-managed keys (KMS) are supported for S3 archival; access to audit logs is role-restricted and requires org_admin or SOC role with MFA. Audit logs are immutable for the configured retention window when Object Lock is enabled."

elaine_s: Can we also include a short note on alerting/monitoring integration? Buyer asked if Redwood can generate detection events for their SIEM (e.g., admin failed login spike).

kiran_sec: Yes — we emit structured detection events to the same audit stream. Example detection event:
```json
{
  "event_type": "detection",
  "timestamp": "2025-10-14T16:20:01Z",
  "detection": "admin_login_failure_spike",
  "severity": "high",
  "aggregate": {"failures": 38, "window_minutes": 5},
  "related_request_ids": ["req_111","req_112"]
}
```

kiran_sec: For realtime monitoring customers can subscribe to webhook alerts or stream into SIEM. We also provide prebuilt Kibana/ES and Splunk dashboards for common operational views (admin actions, auth failures, high-latency deployments).

elaine_s: This is great. Sam — can you craft the email to the buyer including these snippets? I'll attach a PDF one-pager summarizing defaults and the mapping to SIG/CAIQ.

sam_se: Will do — I'll keep the message concise and attach the one-pager.

infra-bot: Deployment logs forwarded to splunk-hec.example.com at 2025-10-14T16:45:12Z (simulated). :white_check_mark:

elaine_s: Thanks team — sending in 30. If Acme wants longer retention we will flag as an add-on for Dedicated/Private contracts.

kiran_sec: Quick follow-up for the one-pager: include contact for SOC review (kiran_sec@redwood.ai) and a pointer to the internal playbook: /confluence/security/logging-siem-integration (we'll export a read-only snapshot for procurement).

elaine_s: Added. :thumbsup:

sam_se: Sent to buyer at 2025-10-14T17:02Z. Subject: "Redwood — SIEM & Audit Trail evidence for Acme procurement"

elaine_s: Marking thread resolved unless buyer responds with additional asks.
